text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I happen upon Rice Shower
outside the
academy gates. Curious, I
ask where she's
headed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Umm, I'm going out to buy a picture
book.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I find myself wondering what kind of
picture
books Rice Shower normally
reads.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You want to come with me? I'd love that!
choice_data_list: よかったら、ついていってもいいかな？
choice_data_list_en: If you don't mind, do you think I could tag along?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: You want to come with me? I'd love that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having given me the green light, we
head out
together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But when we arrive at the bookstore, we
discover
the picture book is sold out.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... I'm sorry, Big Brother... And after I brought you all the way here...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... I'm sorry, Big Sister... And after I brought you all the way here...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Sigh... I really wanted to read that book...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I always feel so calm when I read
them...
choice_data_list: ライスは本当に絵本が好きなんだね
choice_data_list_en: You really do love picture books, Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Through those pages, I can explore
different
worlds and learn so many
wonderful things...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's why I get so excited when I find a
new one
to read!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I was really excited today...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: 歩いて他の店でも探してみようか
予約とかできたりしないかな？
choice_data_list_en: Shall we walk around and look for another shop?
I wonder if we could make a reservation?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no, I couldn't trouble you...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-no, I couldn't trouble you...
choice_data_list: ライスの読みたい絵本が気になってきた
choice_data_list_en: Now I'm curious about the picture book you want to read, Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um...
choice_data_list: ライスの読みたい絵本が気になってきた
choice_data_list_en: Now I'm curious about the picture book you want to read, Rice.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...In that case, let's keep looking for a
little bit
longer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower and I check every nearby
bookstore
we can think of. Then, just as
the sun begins to
set...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Big Brother! Here it is! This is the
book!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Big Sister! Here it is! This is the
book!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We're both excited to find one last copy
at the
final store we visit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We read the picture book together after
we buy
it, and I get an up-close look at
her joyful face.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? R-reserving a copy? I wonder...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We manage to reserve a copy, due to
arrive in
the next shipment!
choice_data_list: 店員さんに聞いてみよう！

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Brother! I never would
have
thought to reserve a copy...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Sister! I never would
have thought
to reserve a copy...
choice_data_list: 一緒に読んでみたくなったからね
choice_data_list_en: Because I wanted to read it with you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Then... let's read it together when it
comes.
choice_data_list: 一緒に読んでみたくなったからね
choice_data_list_en: Because I wanted to read it with you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Then... let's read it together when it
comes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower's face lights up, and I feel
happiness
welling up inside myself too.
